note: Registry of data sources. Each source is a replaceable adapter in arena/sources/ behind a fixed interface, so a licensed provider can replace it without touching the rest of the engine. Current use is personal and non-commercial; raw data is kept in the private archive and never republished.

sources.provider: Yahoo Finance, via the open-source yfinance library
sources.data: daily open, high, low, close (unadjusted for dividends), volume; dividends and splits by ex-date
sources.terms: Unofficial access to a public website; Yahoo terms allow personal use only. Not guaranteed; may block heavy use.
sources.redistribution: not allowed: raw data stays in the private archive; only derived figures are published

sources.provider: European Central Bank, euro foreign exchange reference rates (data portal API)
sources.data: daily EUR/USD reference rate (USD per 1 EUR), set around 14:10 CET
sources.terms: Public official statistics; reuse allowed with source attribution.

sources.data: daily close for a nightly sample of 5 companies, compared with Yahoo
sources.terms: Free plan for personal, internal use; limits on requests and unique symbols per month.
sources.license: Personal use; commercial use needs a paid licence
sources.credentials: API token in the GitHub secret TIINGO_KEY (never in code)
sources.commercial_replacement: Tiingo commercial plan or another licensed vendor

sources.data: tickers, names and sectors of the S&P 100, frozen with a date
sources.terms: Text under CC BY-SA; index composition is a public fact. S&P index names are trademarks of S&P Dow Jones Indices.
sources.redistribution: list of tickers allowed; index data itself not redistributed
sources.commercial_replacement: S&P Dow Jones Indices licence if the product uses the index name commercially
